decisions.reason: As a core upholstery fabric closely related to our existing know-how and given its dedicated presentation, it fits our absorptive capacity well and offers good scope for iterative improvement and commercialisation.

This decorative fabric is close to our established design and interior-textile competencies, so even with only early website visibility we can learn from market feedback and refine it at relatively low knowledge risk.

Its close fit with our curtain business and the added flame-retardant functionality for contract customers make it a strong candidate for retention because our existing R&D base can further adapt and improve it.

Although related to our offer, this wool-blend decoration fabric appears less strongly supported in the market and is less aligned with our push to reduce hard-to-recycle blends, so resources are better shifted to stronger adjacent products.

This fabric still builds on our established decorative and weaving capabilities, and its distinctive semi-transparent bouclé leno character gives us enough related novelty to justify continued learning and market development.
